sum: NeoVolta Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of energy storage systems in the United States. The company provides NV14, NV24, NVPlus, and NV7600 energy storage systems, which stores and uses energy through batteries and an inverter at residential, commercial and industrial, and utility-scale customer products and markets; and NV16 kW AC. It markets and sells its products directly to certified solar installers and regional and national distributors. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Poway, California.
